description:
You are a Forest and Conservation Technician leading a multi-day field traverse along the GR7 long-distance trail from Dole to Langres, France (approximately 124 km). You are preparing the GPS data package for all field team members' Garmin devices.

BaseCamp starts with an empty library. The file 'dole_langres_track.gpx' (the GR7 track data exported from a GNSS receiver) is on the Desktop and must be imported into BaseCamp so it is included in the exported collection.

Create the following 7 waypoints in My Collection with the exact names, coordinates (decimal degrees — note: France has positive (east) longitude values), symbols, and comments shown:

1. Name: DEPART DOLE GARE  |  Lat: 47.0930  Lon: 5.4962  |  Symbol: Car  |  Comment: Day 1 Start. Gare SNCF Dole. Group meeting 08:30. Parking: Rue de Besancon.
2. Name: REPAS LABERGEMENT  |  Lat: 47.1640  Lon: 5.5100  |  Symbol: Food/Water  |  Comment: Lunch stop Day 1. Labergement-Foigney. Water fountain at church. Km 13.5.
3. Name: NUIT 1 PESMES  |  Lat: 47.2770  Lon: 5.5620  |  Symbol: Building  |  Comment: Night 1. Gite Les Chevaliers. Tel: +33 3 84 31 23 91. Reservation required. 28km.
4. Name: NUIT 2 GRAY  |  Lat: 47.4490  Lon: 5.5970  |  Symbol: Building  |  Comment: Night 2. Hotel du Commerce Gray. Tel: +33 3 84 65 11 88. Supermarche nearby. 52km.
5. Name: RAVITAILLEMENT CHAMPLITTE  |  Lat: 47.6183  Lon: 5.5133  |  Symbol: Food/Water  |  Comment: Resupply Champlitte. Boulangerie, Pharmacie, Superette. Open Tue-Sat 08:00-12:30.
6. Name: NUIT 3 JUSSEY  |  Lat: 47.8247  Lon: 5.9046  |  Symbol: Building  |  Comment: Night 3. Camping Municipal Jussey. Tel: +33 3 84 92 11 63. Showers available. 80km.
7. Name: ARRIVEE LANGRES  |  Lat: 47.8620  Lon: 5.3344  |  Symbol: Flag, Blue  |  Comment: Journey end. Langres ramparts (UNESCO). Train back to Dole departs 17:42. 124km total.

Create this route, adding waypoints in the exact order listed:

Route — Name: GR7 DOLE-LANGRES 5 JOURS  |  Waypoints in order: DEPART DOLE GARE, REPAS LABERGEMENT, NUIT 1 PESMES, NUIT 2 GRAY, RAVITAILLEMENT CHAMPLITTE, NUIT 3 JUSSEY, ARRIVEE LANGRES

When done, export the entire My Collection (including the imported track) as a GPX file and save it to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\GR7_Guide_DoleLangres.gpx
